history.title: Crash reporting: the app reports its own crashes to the hub, with the screen it was on
Purifiers: fan speed, the air, filter life, display and child lock; a tap switches them on or off. Security names cameras.
Settings: where the home is, timezone, prayer times, the doorbell pause; the web gets a Settings page
Sign in a browser: type the code your Kova address shows on a computer; sign browsers out
Integrations in the app: what’s connected, add from the catalog, and each one’s setup, linking and pairing on its own screen
Customise home, Energy and Media are the app's own screens; with zones for ducted air conditioners
Ducted air conditioners: zones in the AC panel (name them, open or close, how far open)
Same device twice? Kova suggests combining a device it reaches through two integrations (a soundbar, a TV) into one; Separate from its panel

Redesigned app: real loading/offline/pending/failed states, new device panels, App updates in More (check now, restart to update), location only when nothing else knows you're home; with the Automations screens
Automations: the full list, editor and history, with suggestions and Home Assistant ones to convert
Home and away: the app uses the hub's home-network address at home and its remote address away, switching by itself; addresses under This phone
Feels more physical: presses spring back, sheets rise and follow the finger, tiles cross-fade on and off, sliders show their value with ticks, haptics throughout, and reduced motion respected
Sliders drag properly; pull down to refresh any screen and swipe a panel down to close it; air conditioners (Hisense ConnectLife)
Soundbar panel redesigned: input and sound as tiles, night mode switch, mute by the volume; soundbars show On · input, not Playing
Launches on iOS 27 (UIScene life cycle); no splash hang when the keychain won't read; the widget's build number follows the app's
The TV's source shows which one it's on; soundbar controls
